title: 第二十七章窥伺藏宝得宝第二十八章脱身亲事
slug: 玄幻乱世猎户从箭术到人间武圣
content_zh:
很小的时候，顾晦和一些小伙伴就喜欢来大白崖下面的这个溶洞探险。
溶洞里面四通八达，好几个出口，地形复杂。
不过，这是对初来乍到者而言，像顾晦这样生于斯长于斯的家伙，对这溶洞的熟悉程度不亚于自己的掌纹，进入溶洞后，哪怕里面一片漆黑，他的步伐依旧不慢。
倒不是他视力好到像夜猫子，无非是太熟，另一个就是溶洞的头顶偶尔会出现一些发光的石头，光芒的颜色各异，有时候是幽蓝，有时候是淡黄，有时候是青绿……
光芒非常的微弱，却像前世逃生通道的引路灯的光芒，勉强让你瞧得到脚下的地面。
当然，有些地方没有发光的石头，就只能慢慢前行，哪怕是顾晦也需得放慢脚步摸索。
来到一个稍微宽敞的山窟，头顶有钟乳石垂下，
偶尔有着几个小水洼，垂下的钟乳石上有乳白的水滴落下，滴落在那些水洼内，发出轻响。
个别的钟乳石会发光，山窟并非睁眼不见五指。
这里是大白崖溶洞的中枢，有十几条通道延伸出去，其中，大部分都是死胡同，只有四五条通道才能通往外面。
来到这里后，顾晦突然停下脚步。
他站在原地纹丝不动，隐踪匿迹转而变成寻踪觅迹，全神贯注，侧耳聆听。
耳垂微微抖动，像是被风吹动。
他的确听到了风声。
听到了气流在溶洞内穿行的声音，这声音正从他身后的通道传来，那是他的来时路。
顾晦没有迟疑，很快有了决断。
他并未沿着既定的方向前行，没有往前方的通道奔去，那条通道出口在几十丈外，距离有点远。
他转身猫腰，技能转变为潜踪隐迹。
沿着岩壁往左侧无声地走了几步，那里有个角落，被山石遮挡了光芒，非常漆黑。
顾晦进入角落，双手撑着山壁往上攀升，一个翻身，进入了角落上方的一个夹层。

这个地方非常隐秘。
就算有人来到角落，如果不撑着岩壁往上攀升一两丈，站在下方的话不可能瞧见那个夹层。
以前，顾晦和小伙伴们在溶洞内捉迷藏的时候发现了这个地方，这是他的风水宝地，每次他当老鼠躲在这里，从来没有被猫发现过，并且，这里还有一个好处。
夹层对外有个缝隙，藏在里面，凑在缝隙那里，视线良好，无遮无拦，可以瞧见外面山窟的状况。
顾晦趴在夹层内，透过缝隙居高临下望向外面。
他继续运转隐踪匿迹的技能，呼吸调整到细不可闻，心跳若有若无，就像是传说中的龟息功。
过了一会，山窟内出现了一个身影。
身影穿着灰衣，戴着兜帽，脸上还蒙着一块黑布，顾晦只知道对方身形中等，脚步蹒跚，像是受了重伤，即便如此，仍然听不到他的脚步声。
就像是一个幽灵。
果然，先前的感觉并没错。
如果，那时候继续往通道那边走去，必定会被这个灰衣人瞧见，看这家伙鬼鬼祟祟的样子，不是什么好人，自己若是露了行藏，对方多半会下手灭口。
那人越走越近，来到顾晦先前停下的地方，他也停在了那里。
顾晦不由屏住了呼吸，目光并未继续落在那人的脸上，有些人的感知非常敏锐，内力境武师听说大多有金风未起蝉先觉的感知，若是有人窥伺，必有感应。
顾晦不再直视，只用眼角余光扫描。
那人回头望向来时路，如同顾晦先前那样侧耳聆听，不仅如此，还低头看了看来时路，貌似在看他是不是留下了什么痕迹，若是有的话也就会尽早清除。
看了一会，那人并未行动。
看来，他没有留下被人追踪的痕迹。
接下来，顾晦以为这厮将会快步离开。
然而，他并没有朝那些通道走去，而是朝着自己所在的方向快步走来。
自己被发现了？

顾晦的心咯噔了一下。
content_en:
When he was very young, Gu Hui and some friends liked to explore the cave under Dabai Cliff.
The cave extends in all directions, has several exits, and the terrain is complex.
However, this is for a newcomer. A guy like Gu Hui, who was born and raised here, is as familiar with the cave as his own palm prints. After entering the cave, even if it is pitch dark inside, his pace is still not slow.
It’s not that his eyesight is so good that he looks like a night owl, it’s just that he’s too familiar with it. The other thing is that some luminous stones occasionally appear on the top of the cave. The colors of the light are different, sometimes it’s blue, sometimes it’s light yellow, sometimes it’s green...
The light is very weak, but it is like the light of the guide light of the escape route in the previous life, barely allowing you to see the ground under your feet.
Of course, there are no luminous stones in some places, so you can only move forward slowly. Even Gu Hui needs to slow down and explore.
We came to a slightly spacious cave with stalactites hanging overhead.
Occasionally there are a few small puddles, and milky white water droplets fall from the hanging stalactites, making a soft sound when they fall into the puddles.
Individual stalactites will glow, and the cave is not blind.
This is the center of the Dabai Cliff Cave, with more than a dozen passages extending out. Most of them are dead ends, and only four or five passages can lead to the outside.
After arriving here, Gu Hui suddenly stopped.
He stood motionless, his concealment turning into a search, paying full attention and listening intently.
The earlobes trembled slightly, as if blown by the wind.
He did get wind of it.
He heard the sound of air flowing through the cave. This sound was coming from the passage behind him, which was the way he came.
Gu Hui did not hesitate and quickly made a decision.
He did not move forward in the established direction, and did not run towards the passage ahead. The exit of that passage was dozens of feet away, which was a bit far away.
He turned around and his skill changed to Stealth.
I walked silently for a few steps along the rock wall to the left. There was a corner there, which was blocked by rocks and was very dark.
Gu Hui entered the corner, climbed up the mountain wall with both hands, turned over, and entered a mezzanine above the corner.
This place is very secluded.
Even if someone comes to the corner, if they don't hold on to the rock wall and climb up a foot or two, they won't be able to see the mezzanine if they stand below.
In the past, Gu Hui and his friends discovered this place when they were playing hide-and-seek in the cave. This was his geomantic treasure. Every time he hid here as a mouse, he was never discovered by a cat. Moreover, there was another benefit here.
There is a gap on the mezzanine to the outside. Hidden inside, if you are close to the gap, you have a good line of sight, without any obstruction, and you can see the conditions of the cave outside.
Gu Hui lay on the mezzanine, looking down through the gap outside.
He continued to operate the invisible skills, his breathing was adjusted to be inaudible, and his heartbeat was faint, just like the legendary Turtle Breath Technique.
After a while, a figure appeared in the cave.
The figure was wearing gray clothes, a hood, and a piece of black cloth covering his face. Gu Hui only knew that the figure was of medium height and staggered, as if he had been seriously injured. Even so, his footsteps could not be heard.
Like a ghost.
Sure enough, the previous feeling was correct.
If you continue walking towards the passage at that time, you will definitely be seen by the man in gray. Judging from the sneaky appearance of this guy, he is not a good person. If he reveals his hidden identity, the other party will probably silence him.
The man walked closer and closer, and came to the place where Gu Hui stopped before, and he also stopped there.
Gu Hui couldn't help but hold his breath, and his eyes did not continue to fall on the man's face. Some people's perceptions are very keen. It is said that most martial arts masters in the inner strength realm have the ability to sense the cicada before the golden wind rises. If someone is watching, they will definitely sense it.
Gu Hui stopped looking directly and only scanned with the corner of his eye.
The man looked back at the way he came, like Gu HuixianNot only that, he also lowered his head and looked at Shi Lu, seemingly looking to see if he had left any traces, and if so, he would clear them as soon as possible.
After watching for a while, the man didn't move.
It seemed that he left no trace of being followed.
Next, Gu Hui thought that this guy would leave quickly.
However, he did not walk towards those passages, but walked quickly in the direction where he was.
Have you been discovered?
Gu Hui's heart skipped a beat.
